units.title: SG-2.2 Author the boy sheet and portrait
Act: Author the boy sheet frames in boy.ts
units.failure: Act agent reported ok:false: BLOCKED, not done. I wrote game/frontend/src/art/boy.ts with boyFrame (32x48 grid, draw.ts helpers, hoodie/parchment/indigo, outlines), the three pose arrays (IDLE 4, WALK 6, INTERACT 4) and BOY_SHEET_SOURCE (id 'character:boy-sheet', 14 frames). Before I could check it, another writer replaced the file on disk with a different module: boyPortraitGrid / BOY_PORTRAIT_SOURCE / BOY_SOURCES, which has no boyFrame or BOY_SHEET_SOURCE. The worktree also has uncommitted changes from that same session in sources.ts, lib/generateAssets.ts and public/assets/worlds/the-boys-room/manifest.json, plus an untracked public/assets/ui/cursors/hand.png. I did not overwrite the file, because that would discard another session's in-progress work. The ticket's Expected results (boyFrame returns 48x32, arrays 4/6/4, BOY_SHEET_SOURCE.frames.length 14) are not verifiable against the disk state. Next step: confirm with whoever owns the boy-portrait work whether boy.ts should be replaced, or whether boyFrame and BOY_SHEET_SOURCE should go in a separate file. Then re-apply the content from step 1 to 3. Typecheck (npx tsc --noEmit) reports only pre-existing errors in tests/*.test.ts(x) and tests/tailwindConfig.test.ts; none are in src/art/boy.ts. Not run: the boyFrame shape check, because the first attempt failed on a missing `timeout` binary and the rerun was blocked by the file change.

units.title: Act: Author the 32x32 boy portrait source
units.failure: Act agent reported ok:false: Created game/frontend/src/art/boy.ts with boyPortraitGrid(), BOY_PORTRAIT_SOURCE (id 'character:boy-portrait', path 'worlds/the-boys-room/characters/boy-portrait.png', frames [boyPortraitGrid()]) and BOY_SOURCES. Adaptations: (1) Step 1's 'after BOY_SHEET_SOURCE' anchor did not exist. boy.ts was not in the repo and nothing in src/ defines BOY_SHEET_SOURCE; the boy sheet exists only as public/assets/worlds/the-boys-room/characters/boy-sheet.svg, which is not generated from a source. I created the file fresh. (2) Step 2 expects BOY_SOURCES to have two entries, [BOY_SHEET_SOURCE, BOY_PORTRAIT_SOURCE]. That is not achievable without inventing a sheet source, which is out of scope, so BOY_SOURCES = [BOY_PORTRAIT_SOURCE] (one entry). This is the open item: the expected two-entry result is unmet until someone defines the boy sheet source. The grid uses the helpers in draw.ts, with the palette ramps parchment, hoodie, indigo and wood, which all exist in lib/palette.ts. Type check: `npx tsc --noEmit` reports 0 errors in src/art/boy.ts; the 8 existing errors are all in tests/ and predate this change. I did not run a grid-dimension check; the 32x32 size follows from createGrid(32,32,0) and 32 rows by construction. Not wired into generateArt.ts, which only consumes ART_SOURCES, so the portrait is exported but not generated yet. Unexpected changes: while I worked, git status showed changes I did not make: modified game/frontend/src/art/sources.ts (added AnimationDef/Origin imports and optional animations/origin fields), game/frontend/src/lib/generateAssets.ts, game/public/assets/worlds/the-boys-room/manifest.json, untracked game/public/assets/ui/cursors/hand.png, and node_modules vitest results. I left them untouched; they look like another session or process, and boy.ts does not depend on them.

units.title: Act: Carry animations and origin into generated entries and register boy sources
units.failure: Act agent reported ok:false: Blocked on steps 2 (partly) and 4. Step 1 done: ArtSource in game/frontend/src/art/sources.ts now has optional animations and origin, imported as types from '@game/assets/manifest' (the types exist in game/src/assets/manifest/schema.ts). Step 3 done: both entries.push calls in game/frontend/src/lib/generateAssets.ts spread animations and origin only when the source has them. Step 2 done: ART_SOURCES is [cursor-hand, ...BOY_SOURCES], importing BOY_SOURCES from './boy'. Step 4 is NOT done: BOY_SHEET_SOURCE does not exist anywhere in the worktree, and the boy sheet's frames 0-13 (idle/walk/interact) have no palette-grid source; only SVGs exist under game/public/assets/worlds/the-boys-room/characters/. I did not invent 14 frames of pixel art. Also, game/frontend/src/art/boy.ts appeared mid-run as an untracked file written by another process: it exports only BOY_PORTRAIT_SOURCE and BOY_SOURCES = [portrait], and its own header says BOY_SHEET_SOURCE is missing. I did not edit it. The portrait is the only boy source registered, so the step 2 expectation ('cursor-hand then the boy sheet and portrait') is only half met. Verification: npx tsc --noEmit shows no errors in src/; the only errors are pre-existing ones in tests/ (bootScene, layout, phaserHost, story, tailwindConfig). npx vitest run tests/generateAssets.test.ts tests/roomSources.test.ts: 50 passed. Running vitest modified the tracked cache game/frontend/node_modules/.vite/vitest/results.json; I restored it with git checkout. After that, git status showed changes I did not make: results.json staged as M, and boy.ts as staged-deleted plus untracked. I did not run git add and did not touch the index again. To finish, someone needs to supply the boy sheet's frame grids and animation frame layout (or confirm that the sheet is provided elsewhere), then add BOY_SHEET_SOURCE with animations idle {frames:[0,1,2,3],frameRate:6,repeat:-1}, walk {frames:[4..9],frameRate:10,repeat:-1}, interact {frames:[10..13],frameRate:8,repeat:0} and origin {x:0.5,y:1}, and include it in BOY_SOURCES. Baseline cited: scan v1, tip 9cda5131c65b08541fc685d8a0898d39a0e9e9fa.

units.title: Act: Generate boy PNGs and manifest entries with art:generate
units.failure: Act agent reported ok:false: Blocked: `npm run art:generate` does not produce the boy PNGs or the two manifest entries, because the generator's source list has no boy sources. (1) ART_SOURCES in game/frontend/src/art/sources.ts contains only ui/cursor-hand. Its uncommitted BOY_SOURCES in game/frontend/src/art/boy.ts (character:boy-portrait) is not imported or registered there. (2) No source produces character:boy-sheet; boy.ts says the sheet source does not exist. Wiring these in is another unit's work and is outside this step, so I did not edit sources.ts. Other changes: the brief's manifest path game/frontend/public/... does not exist; generator's defaultArtPaths resolves to game/public/assets/worlds/the-boys-room/manifest.json, which I used. The generator also failed at first with 'zod' not found, so I ran `npm ci` in game/ (declared deps, lockfile, no lockfile change). The run then wrote only ui/cursors/hand.png and reformatted the manifest with an added ui/cursor-hand entry, not the boy entries. I reverted the manifest with git checkout and deleted the generated hand.png, so the tree has no output from this run. Uncommitted changes to sources.ts, generateAssets.ts and boy.ts came from other work, and I left them. To unblock: register BOY_SOURCES (and a boy-sheet source) in ART_SOURCES, then rerun art:generate.
